mentions.name: AI agent orchestration harness
mentions.description: A harness for directing and orchestrating AI agents across multiple hours or days of work, built while the author learns AI Systems Engineering.
mentions.problem: Helping software engineers stay relevant and secure their jobs as AI agents become more capable.
mentions.audience: The author, a software engineer (framed as helping job security for software engineers)
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on learning enough AI Systems Engineering, in order to get to the point where I can direct and orchestrate AI agents for multiple hours/days and building a harness to help with that.
mentions.author: SuperGent
